summary: PR-1823 changes only the in-memory log buffer size in AppLog.java, a security-sensitive logging component. The security review was given by Declan Farrell, a change approver who lacks the security_reviewer role, so CHG-5 is violated. The CI evidence is also invalid: the JUnit reports predate the head commit and come from a developer workstation, not the recorded CI executor. LOG-1 cannot be shown, because only a sample-coverage control test exists against an exhaustive requirement. The change is rejected.
